clue.text: Spots King's remains

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king (Rex)
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A monarch's remains are blemished with spots.
explanation.definitionFit: A rash is an outbreak of red spots on the skin, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Newspaper article on endlessly bungling street Arab

parts.note: a rag is slang for a low-quality newspaper
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter is removed

parts.note: muffing means bungling, as in muffing a catch

explanation.surface: A newspaper story about a hopeless homeless child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Street Arab' is an old term for a homeless child living on the streets.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragamuffin is a ragged, dirty child, much as the dated phrase describes a street urchin.

clue.text: Hard centre of lump? It's bone

parts.note: stern means hard or severe

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: A hard lump turns out to be bone at its core.
explanation.definitionFit: The sternum is the breastbone, so it is a specific bone of the chest.

clue.text: Unusual RC rituals involving page of the Bible?

indicators.note: involving means one piece wraps round another, here the rearranged letters around the page
unusual signals that the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Odd Roman Catholic rites that bring in a page from the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Something scriptural relates to holy writ, so it is of the Bible; the question mark marks the definition by example.

clue.text: Observe annoying child being taken into church shelter

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: being taken into means this piece goes inside the next word

parts.note: lee is shelter from the wind
a brat is an annoying child

explanation.surface: Someone watches as a naughty child is brought into a church refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe a festival or anniversary is to celebrate it.

clue.text: Opening paint-roller, removing packaging

indicators.note: removing the packaging strips the outer letters to leave the inner run

explanation.surface: Unwrapping a new paint-roller at the start of a decorating job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Opening' looks like the act of unwrapping, but it is the definition; the letters sit inside PAINTROLLER once PA and LLER are stripped.
explanation.definitionFit: An intro, short for introduction, is the opening of a piece of music or writing.

clue.text: Astute research mistaken in dismissing a source of wealth

indicators.note: mistaken signals the letters are put into the wrong, new order
dismissing means the following letter is taken out of the fodder

explanation.surface: Clever research goes wrong by overlooking a source of riches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in dismissing' removes one A from ASTUTE RESEARCH, and 'mistaken' rearranges the remaining thirteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasure chest is a box of riches, and figuratively any rich source of valuable things.

clue.text: Cheese company having last of Camembert snatched by woman

indicators.note: snatched by means these pieces are seized inside the woman's name

parts.note: Rita is a woman's name

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A woman grabs a firm's final piece of Camembert cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricotta is a soft Italian whey cheese, an example of the category.

clue.text: Was without heart and was untrue

indicators.note: without heart means the middle letter of the word is removed

parts.note: to have lived is to have been, so was can mean lived

explanation.surface: Someone was heartless and unfaithful.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lied said what was false, so they were untrue in speech.

clue.text: Set to receive gash from this monster?

indicators.note: to receive means the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: to gel is to set, as a jelly does
rend means tear or gash

explanation.surface: Someone is told to prepare for a wound inflicted by a monster.
explanation.walkthrough: Grendel is the monster slain by the hero in the Old English poem Beowulf.
explanation.definitionFit: Grendel is the famous man-eating monster of the Anglo-Saxon epic, an example of the category named.

clue.text: Relish vital statistics, perhaps, revealed in boudoir item

parts.note: a dressing is a sauce or relish for food
vital statistics can be set out in a table of figures

explanation.surface: A woman's measurements are on show at her bedroom mirror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vital statistics' usually means bust, waist and hip measurements, but here it is figures laid out in a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A dressing table is a piece of bedroom furniture with mirror and drawers, typical of a boudoir.

clue.text: New production of Lear etc, is cloying stuff

indicators.note: a new production of a play reworks it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fresh staging of King Lear and others is sickly and sentimental.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is thick sweet syrup, and figuratively cloying sentimental material.

clue.text: Fractal quantities unexpectedly demonstrable with time

indicators.note: unexpectedly signals the letters of the next word come out in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: Mathematical quantities turn out, surprisingly, to be provable given enough time.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mandelbrot set is the best-known fractal, a set of complex numbers, hence quantities.

clue.text: Very keen on diatribe about the French, being bigoted

indicators.note: about means the outer pieces go round the French article

parts.note: to be into something is to be very keen on it
a rant is a diatribe
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone fond of ranting about the French is a bigot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reads as 'on the subject of', but it is a container signal: the French article sits inside the keen-on-plus-diatribe pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Intolerant means unwilling to accept other views, so bigoted.

clue.text: No end of worry about me getting the vapours

indicators.note: about means the trimmed word goes round the other piece
no end of means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to fuss is to worry
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone frets endlessly about themselves and gets a fit of nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The vapours' sounds like an old-fashioned fit of nerves, but here it is literal: gases. 'No end of' trims worry's synonym to FUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Fumes are gases or vapours given off by something, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Make sure a trace is disguised in offence

indicators.note: in means the disguised letters sit inside the word for offence

parts.note: a sin is an offence or transgression

indicators.note: a disguised word has its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: To be certain, a clue left behind is hidden within a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is disguised' rearranges the clue's trace to CERTA; 'Make sure' looks like an instruction but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to find out for certain, which is to make sure of something.

clue.text: What at first can assist training kittens, say

definitions.text: What at first can assist training kittens, say

indicators.note: at first picks the opening letter of each following word

parts.note: a litter is a brood of young animals, kittens for example

explanation.surface: Something that helps house-train young cats.
explanation.definitionFit: Cat litter is the granular material in a tray that helps house-train kittens.

clue.text: Showing teamwork when performing live

definitions.meaning: playing on stage before an audience

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means acting jointly in agreement, and also performing at a live show of music.

clue.text: Good number have part of head covering in this style?

indicators.note: covering means the outer word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: the chin is part of the head

explanation.surface: A head covering worn in a certain fashion by a good few people.
explanation.walkthrough: A chignon is a knot of hair at the back of the head, so the head covering is the hair itself, styled this way.
explanation.definitionFit: A chignon is a hairstyle with the hair coiled at the nape, so the style named.

clue.text: Small group of people getting round instrument

parts.note: a cell is a small group, as in a terrorist cell
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A small band gathers round a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The cello is a large bowed string instrument, an example of the category.

clue.text: Student's left a well-paid job

definitions.note: read as 'Student is', the 's linking definition to wordplay

parts.note: a nice little earner is British slang for a lucrative job

explanation.surface: A student has quit a lucrative job.
explanation.walkthrough: An 'earner', as in 'a nice little earner', is British slang for a profitable job.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner is someone studying, so a student.

clue.text: Concentrated, having cause for anxiety giving life-saving treatment

parts.note: intensive means concentrated or thorough
a care is a worry, something causing anxiety

explanation.surface: A focused, worrying time for a patient receiving emergency treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: Intensive care is the hospital unit giving constant treatment to critically ill patients.

clue.text: Near end of it? That's when it's darkest

parts.note: nigh means near

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Approaching the end, when things look blackest.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is the time of darkness, so the period when it is darkest.

clue.text: First in class — in Latin, this is smart

indicators.note: first in picks the opening letter of the word

parts.note: hic is Latin for this

explanation.surface: The top pupil in the Latin class is clever.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish or elegant, which is smart in the fashionable sense.

clue.text: Some letters on pencil, silver, in reticule

parts.note: pencil leads are graded with letters, H (hard) and B (black, soft)
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A pencil and some silver are tucked into a lady's little bag.
explanation.walkthrough: The letter pair is read as the phrase 'H and B', the grades stamped on pencils, giving its letters in full.
explanation.definitionFit: A reticule is an old-fashioned small drawstring bag carried by women, a kind of handbag.

clue.text: Name of liner shortly revealed, a Queen

indicators.note: shortly means the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: the Titanic was the famous liner that sank in 1912

explanation.surface: The name of a ship is briefly unveiled, with a queen in attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: Titania is the queen of the fairies in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream.

clue.text: Think to do card tricks including shuffling etc.

indicators.note: including means the first word holds the shuffled letters inside it

parts.note: to conjure is to perform magic tricks, card tricks among them

indicators.note: shuffling, as of a pack, rearranges the letters

explanation.surface: A magician considers doing card tricks with a shuffle and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shuffling' rearranges the clue's etc to ECT; 'Think' heads the clue as the definition, though it reads like a command.
explanation.definitionFit: To conjecture is to guess or suppose, so to think something without proof.

clue.text: Brash young type runs into club

indicators.note: into means the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: a bat is a club used in cricket or baseball
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A cheeky youngster dashes into a nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' suggests a nightclub, but it is a bat.
explanation.definitionFit: A brat is a cheeky, ill-behaved child, a brash young person.
